_readme: Approval registry of internal link targets (customer rule 2026-11-14: links may lead ONLY to resources created/approved by the customer). Target = path[?category=x] without #hash. approved:true = allowed; approved:false = forbidden (gate FAIL); a target not listed here = FAIL. `pending` = awaiting customer approval: gate reports PENDING (not FAIL). Edited by the orchestrator only; the customer approves the registry.

approved.note: generated hub: not a link target (customer 2026-11-14)

pending.note: product pages /products/<slug>/ linked from the catalog: pending customer approval

ignoredHashOnly: href="#id" in-page anchors are checked against ids in the same page; bare '#' is a FAIL

approvedPatterns.note: contact form prefilled with a product (from product pages)

excludePages.note: internal design-system documentation, not a public page (has demo '#' links)

selfLinks: a generated hub page may link to ITS OWN url/DE twin only (language switch); this is not a link to a hub from another page
